scientific_integrity: The recurrence and all supporting algebra are independently derived from the stated definition. Finite exact integer checks substantiate but do not prove the unrestricted result. Historical priority is best-knowledge; independently certified priority is not claimed.
scientific_limitations: The all-prime-subset closed expression applies to squarefree n>1. For nonsquarefree n the theorem proves parity, not an exact formula. The prime criterion is a consequence of the full theorem; no efficiency or absolute historical novelty is asserted.
title: Exact squarefree values of a quadratic generalized Möbius recurrence
